_comment: PayCraft layer-3 bundled fallback. TEMPLATE — copy into your app and edit before shipping. Android: app/src/main/assets/paycraft-fallback.json. iOS: add to the app target's Copy Bundle Resources. JVM/desktop: place on the classpath root. Web: not used (no app binary to bundle into).
_why: Rendered only when the network AND the persisted cache have both failed. Its job is to keep a purchasable surface in front of a user who would otherwise see a spinner, so prices here are a last resort and will not match a dashboard change made after the app was built.
